description_en: Queries the download URL of export results for a data export ticket
description_zh: 调用GetDataExportDownloadURL获取数据导出结果附件下载地址
name: GetDataExportDownloadURL

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to query the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465817.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465818.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ticket ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html operation to query the ticket ID
parameters.help_zh: 工单ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465867.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used to call the API operation
parameters.help_zh: 实际调用API的用户的阿里云账号UID
parameters.name: real_login_user_uid

DownloadURLResult.description_en: The details of the download URL of the file that records the export results for the ticket

HasResult.description_en:
Indicates whether export results are available for download. Valid values:

true
false
HasResult.description_zh:
是否有下载结果，返回值如下：
true：有下载结果
false：没有下载结果

TipMessage.description_en: The message that indicates an exception

URL.description_en: The download URL of the file that records the export results for the ticket

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
